name: 基于事件的收入确认 - 使用高级执行 (6AK)
name_en: Event-Based Revenue Recognition – Service with Adv. Execution (6AK)
description_en_html:
Overview

Event-Based Revenue Recognition allows you to manage revenue recognition for maintenance service orders. The revenue recognition keys for maintenance service orders are derived based on the billing relevance attribute in the order. For a maintenance service order, cost is generated from time and expenses posted against the service confirmation or goods movements for the plant maintenance order that is assigned to the maintenance service order item. Event-Based Revenue Recognition allows you to recognize revenue based on an invoice simulation for these cost postings. Billed revenue from invoicing the maintenance service order is deferred; the deferred and accrued revenue are balanced during period-end closing.

Key Process Flow

  • Monitor revenue recognition for service documents
  • Manage real-time revenue recognition issues
  • Run revenue recognition for service documents in period-end closing
  • Manage revenue recognition issues for service documents
  • Review service actuals

Business Benefits

  • Ensure the matching between costs and revenue for maintenance service orders
  • Ensure correctness of posted values after period-end closing, with no separate settlement required
  • Automate recognition activities and reduce manual effort during the period and at period-end closing
  • Avoid the need for additional reconciliation
description_zh_html:
概览

基于事件的收入确认允许您管理维护服务订单的收入确认。根据订单中的开票相关性属性，派生维护服务订单的收入确认码。对于维护服务订单，成本是根据分配给维护服务订单项目的工厂维护订单的服务确认或货物移动过账的时间和费用生成的。基于事件的收入确认允许您根据这些成本过账的发票模拟确认收入。为维护服务订单开发票的已开票收入递延；递延和应计收入在期末关账期间结平。

关键流程流

  • 监控服务凭证的收入确认
  • 管理实时收入确认问题
  • 在期末关账时运行服务凭证的收入确认
  • 管理服务凭证的收入确认问题
  • 查看服务实际值

业务优势

  • 确保维护服务订单的成本和收入之间的匹配。
  • 确保期末关账后过账值的正确性，无需单独结算
  • 在期间和期末关账期间，自动执行确认活动，并减少手动工作量
  • 避免需要附加对账
